projects.name: projects

attributes.title: Contract Analysis RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Approach to Legal Q&A
attributes.summary: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for precise contract analysis, improving accuracy and efficiency in answering legal queries. Implemented text chunking, semantic search, and tested different embedding models to enhance retrieval and response generation. Evaluated the system using RAGAS metrics, ensuring accuracy and precision in the system.

attributes.title: RAG Optimization techniques
attributes.summary:
Developed and optimized a high-performance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system tailored for the CNN/Daily Mail dataset. Leveraged LangChain, pgvector, and GPT-4o to enhance answer accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness. Conducted rigorous benchmarking and analysis using RAGAS, implementing and evaluating key optimizations:

Prompt engineering: Crafted effective prompts to guide the language model's responses.
Hybrid retrieval: Combined BM25 and dense embeddings for more robust document retrieval.
Multi-query retriever: Implemented a multi-query strategy to improve retrieval accuracy.
Chunking strategies: Optimized document chunking for better context retrieval.
Embedding models: Experimented with various embedding models to enhance semantic understanding.

For more details  on the results and implementations, check out the github repository.

attributes.title: Building a Redash Chatbot LLM with GPT by OpenAI
attributes.summary: We build a Redash chatbot that streamlines data exploration for non-technical members, transforming complex SQL queries into natural language conversations. This empowers non-technical stakeholders to directly access and analyze key business metrics within Redash and make informed decisions without needing SQL expertise.
